Wafer-scale SRAM (Cerebras-style) vs our HBM ASIC on GLM-5.2 agent workload: $3.30/Mtok vs $0.044 — 76x more expensive per token. Even a 4x-cheaper wafer with 4x KV room: still 11x. Root cause: SRAM $/GB is 20-50x HBM and 744GB of weights leave ~10GB for KV -> batch 13 vs our 226. Per-wafer SPEED is great (11.9k tok/s) — it's a latency product, not a cost product.

Structural: Cerebras's own big-model mode (weight streaming from MemoryX) abandons SRAM-residency — the wafer story only closes for <=44GB models. MoE trend (huge total params, sparse activation) is maximally hostile to SRAM economics; SRAM scaling stalled at N3 while HBM4 doubles. The gap WIDENS over time in our favor for cost-serving.

Strategic synthesis for Josh: opportunity real — 3 stacked layers (market price 2-4x over best-practice cost; our software+surgery 1.6x median under best-practice; batch-agent focus solves the utilization cold-start structurally). Sequencing software->hardware CORRECT: day-1 business on rented GPUs, ASIC is a computed volume milestone (~1T tok/day), surgery IP = chip spec (P(cheaper chip)=0.98). Top risks: GTM/anchor-volume, healing-at-scale, edge erosion (hence auto-research machine as product).

Twin surgery round 1 complete. (1) Granite-1b-a400m routing over 199k tokens: NO exploitable expert locality — mean Gini 0.28, 80%-coverage needs ~20/32 experts/layer, 99.2% of tokens span >1 of 4 expert groups (mean 2.87); aux-loss balancing erased locality. (2) SmolLM2-135M real head surgery 9->6 Q-heads (GQA-valid, -4.9% params): ppl 16.60 -> 82.48 pruned -> 15.91 healed (1500 steps / 12.3M tokens / 124 min MPS; converged by step 500). Healed beats baseline via wikitext adaptation — matched control finetune of unpruned baseline running to isolate true surgery cost. (3) barge Metal f16: 1244 -> 1308 out tok/s (+5.2%) with pruned checkpoint loading unmodified (head_dim=64 honored). (4) KV fake-quant: int8 KV free (+0.012 ppl), all-int4 +5.12; per-layer int4 ranking graded — L19/L16/L1 most sensitive, L0/L8/L6 free; mixed 20xint4+10xint8 verified +1.65 ppl at -33% KV bytes vs all-int8. The load-bearing bet: the machine re-earns the surgery edge per new model family faster than families churn.
